title: Bubbling Magma Pool
description: A wide pool of molten rock churns sluggishly in a natural depression, its surface cracking and reforming in patterns of orange and black. Cooled crusts along the edges crumble into glittering ember dust, and bits of debris from above float briefly before sinking into the glow. The radiant heat is almost unbearable, but strangely soothing at a distance.

choices.label: Skim the cooled edges
choices.description: Scrape the ember-rich crust from the hardened margins of the pool.

outcomes.text: The crusted edges break apart into piles of fine ember dust, still warm and faintly glowing. You fill every pouch you have.
A decent amount of dust, though the best deposits are dangerously close to the molten surface.
The crust gives way underfoot! You lurch backward as your boot plunges into searing heat. Burns race up your leg.

choices.label: Fish out debris
choices.description: Use a long pole to drag floating debris to the edge before it melts.

outcomes.text: You hook something heavy — a half-melted chest! Inside, coins have fused together but are still valuable. A scorched fang floats nearby.
A few coins and a lump of volcanic glass bob to the surface. You drag them to safety before they sink.
The pole catches fire before you reach anything useful. A splatter of magma arcs toward your party.

choices.label: Rest near the warmth
choices.description: Sit at a safe distance and let the deep heat ease the party's wounds.

outcomes.text: At a comfortable distance, the radiant warmth is almost pleasant. Tension melts from tired bodies as you rest.
The heat helps, though the sulfur smell makes breathing difficult. A brief rest, then back to the march.
A bubble of magma bursts nearby, spraying droplets that sizzle against exposed skin. So much for resting — but the heat did ease some aches first.
